<a id="每个变化之律下的复现--recurrence-under-every-law-of-change"></a>
# Recurrence under every law of change

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> For every law of change within finitely many configurations, merging nothing is returning is keeping every possibility, and a rise needs a merge; becoming that keeps its history loses nothing, never returns and needs openness, and a finite present forgets; no premise is used.

`recurrence-without-premise` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

Editable record: [recurrence-without-premise.json](recurrence-without-premise.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-16T18:25:05+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every law of change on configurations of any kind, with no premise and no decidability. Pigeonhole: a list holding the first l.length + 1 values of a sequence holds two equal ones (revisits_within, using membership as given); so a sequence held by a list revisits from every step on (revisits_from), as does every run of every process (Run.revisits_from), and no list holds a sequence that never revisits (unheld_of_new, unlisted_of_new). Where a quantity of the configuration never falls along a sequence and rises across every change (Marks), the change of a sequence held by a list does not recur (Marks.change_not_recurring, Run.change_not_recurring). Under a determined law next (Law.orbit): a configuration not reachable at a step is not reachable at any later step (Law.lost_stays; for every process, reachability lost along an admissible path is lost along every continuation, Reach.lost_stays); merged configurations are never told apart again (Law.merged_stays); where every configuration returns the law merges nothing (Law.lossless_of_returns); a configuration that returns can be had at every step (Branching.Returns.reachable at Law.process); undoing is going on (Law.Returns.undo). Where a list holds every configuration: the law merges nothing (Law.Lossless) exactly where every configuration returns (Law.lossless_iff_returns), and exactly where every configuration can be had at every step (Law.returns_iff_keeps); a merge loses a possibility for good (Law.Merges.loses); a law merging nothing under which some configuration never returns has no list holding every configuration (Law.Lossless.unlisted); merging nothing, a quantity that never falls along an orbit keeps its value (Law.Lossless.no_rise), so one that never falls and rises at some step needs a merge (Law.rise_not_lossless). Open witnesses: Nat.succ merges nothing, never returns, cannot have 0 again after one step and rises at every step (Law.succ_open); Nat.pred merges 0 and 1, yet every number can be had at every step (Law.pred_open). Keeping its history (Law.withHistory: the present goes on by the law and passes into the past), every law merges nothing (Law.withHistory_lossless), never revisits (Law.withHistory_new) and never returns (Law.withHistory_never_returns); its beginning cannot be had again after the first step (Law.withHistory_loses_beginning), and no list holds the kept history (Law.withHistory_unlisted); the present goes on by the law itself (Law.present_orbit), and where it returns it comes back with another history (Law.return_keeps_history); where a list holds the configurations an unfolding passes through, from every step on two different histories share one present (Law.present_forgets). A determined law is a process of the spine, and its orbit a run of it (Law.process, Law.run).

Canonical source: [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise about the unfolding or the law of change, and no decidability. That a list holds the configurations is assumed of no unfolding; it is the condition written into each law that uses it.
- Commitment of the representation: discrete steps. The equivalence of losing nothing, returning and keeping every possibility is stated for determined laws (next : S → S); revisiting, change stopping and lost reachability staying lost are stated for every process.

This is one path for Ren's question of 11 October 2026, ‘if "lossless exist", can we find a path, to figure out, and prove along the way?’, taken with no premise as Ren asked (‘zero-premise, zero axiom(we are not physics, we derive further)’). The spine's rest laws (continued-change-needs-openness) take the first law and dissipation as premises; this result lies a level below: within finitely many configurations, losing nothing is returning, an arrow needs a merge, and never revisiting needs openness. Under the first law an enclosed family has finitely many configurations, and where change is a function of the configuration this result applies to it (the entropy session's Web.Determined; the instance theorems wait for both to land). On the AI's reading lossless exchange exists in exactly two places, return within finitely many configurations and becoming that keeps its history, the latter needing openness; the low-entropy beginning physics supplies is the beginning of the kept history, and is derived; entropy reads as the forgetting of a finite present. These readings are not physical derivations.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 68 declarations of Becoming.Recurrence (55 theorems) all have empty axiom reports (first compiled from the prelude in a scratch tree against the committed core sources, each checked with #print axioms); the same receipt covers the 75 modules of the package and a core closure of 77 modules, every source declaration with an empty axiom report, and checks that the core compiles from Lean's prelude alone; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. Not yet independently reviewed; the author's counterreview is in section 68 of the integration note.

Discrete steps; ‘finitely many configurations’ means that a list holds them, not a cardinality; the equivalence of losing nothing, returning and keeping every possibility is for determined laws (for every process the three come apart: keeping every possibility does not give returning, a merge need not lose a possibility, merging nothing gives returning along runs; see returning-where-the-course-branches, P81); ‘the present forgets’ means that two different histories share one present, and no count of what is forgotten (which needs equality of configurations decided) is stated; ‘change does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing changes; the mathematics (pigeonhole; an injection of a finite set into itself is a bijection, every point of which returns) is reused; the readings as entropy, as karmic passing and as physics are the AI's; the entropy session's results are given as its instances (Becoming.Entropy); no ethical predicate; not yet independently reviewed.

- The condition of finitely many configurations is needed both ways: Nat.succ merges nothing yet never returns, loses its beginning and rises at every step (Law.succ_open), and Nat.pred merges yet keeps every possibility (Law.pred_open).
